notes.scope: The 20 permanent locations named on the current Adoption Island map page. Rotating weather shops, removed buildings, event maps, player houses, and the Neighborhood are excluded.
notes.imagePolicy: Use exact current location thumbnails from each individual wiki page.

item.name: Accessory Shop
item.mapPosition: Between the Safety Hub and Beach Party
item.purpose: Sells pet accessories
item.cardSummary: Accessory Shop is a shop. It is located between the Safety Hub and Beach Party. Sells pet accessories.

item.name: Baby Shop
item.purpose: Sells items and strollers to players
item.cardSummary: Baby Shop is a shop. It is located next to the Playground. Sells items and strollers to players.

item.name: Beach Shop
item.purpose: Sells items to players and allows them to tame Mahi Mahi
item.cardSummary: Beach Shop is a shop. It is located near the beach. Sells items to players and allows them to tame Mahi Mahi.

item.name: Camping Shop
item.purpose: Sells camping-themed items
item.cardSummary: Camping Shop is a shop. It is located near the Campsite. Sells camping-themed items.

item.name: Coffee Shop
item.mapPosition: Between the Playground and Neighborhood tunnel
item.purpose: Sells beverages and Honey
item.cardSummary: Coffee Shop is a shop. It is located between the Playground and Neighborhood tunnel. Sells beverages and Honey.

item.name: Green Groceries
item.mapPosition: The northeast section of the map
item.purpose: Sells food items to players
item.cardSummary: Green Groceries is a shop. It is located in the northeast section of the map. Sells food items to players.

item.name: Ice Cream Shop
item.purpose: To provide players with food items and Golden Goldfish
item.cardSummary: Ice Cream Shop is a shop. It is located beside the Neighborhood tunnel. To provide players with food items and Golden Goldfish.

item.name: Pet Shop
item.mapPosition: To the left of the Nursery
item.purpose: Sells pets and pet-themed items
item.cardSummary: Pet Shop is a shop. It is located to the left of the Nursery. Sells pets and pet-themed items.

item.name: Sky Castle
item.purpose: Sells Potions to players
item.cardSummary: Sky Castle is a shop. It is located above Adoption Island. Sells Potions to players.

item.name: Vehicle Dealership
item.purpose: Sells vehicles
item.cardSummary: Vehicle Dealership is a shop. It is located next to the Salon. Sells vehicles.

item.name: Beach Party
item.mapPosition: At the outskirts of Adoption Island, near the wooden bridge and a stone arch bridge, and between the Safety Hub and Baby Shop
item.purpose: Fulfills the Beach Party need and provides lake activities
item.cardSummary: Beach Party is a need location. It is located at the outskirts of Adoption Island, near the wooden bridge and a stone arch bridge, and between the Safety Hub and Baby Shop. Fulfills the Beach Party need and provides lake activities.

item.name: Campsite
item.mapPosition: Between Green Groceries and the Vehicle Dealership
item.purpose: Fulfills the Camping ailment
item.cardSummary: Campsite is a need location. It is located between Green Groceries and the Vehicle Dealership. Fulfills the Camping ailment.

item.name: Hospital
item.purpose: Heal a player's baby or pet
item.cardSummary: Hospital is a need location. It is located behind the Nursery. Heal a player's baby or pet.

item.name: Pizza Shop
item.purpose: To provide players with food items, jobs, and to fulfill the 'Pizza Party' ailment
item.cardSummary: Pizza Shop is a need and job location. It is located on Adoption Island. To provide players with food items, jobs, and to fulfill the 'Pizza Party' ailment.

item.name: Playground
item.purpose: Cures the Bored ailment
item.cardSummary: Playground is a need location. It is located next to the Coffee Shop. Cures the Bored ailment.

item.name: Salon
item.purpose: Allows players to change their pet's color, work a job, and fulfill the 'Salon' ailment
item.cardSummary: Salon is a need and job location. It is located on Adoption Island. Allows players to change their pet's color, work a job, and fulfill the 'Salon' ailment.

item.name: School
item.mapPosition: In the center of Adoption Island, opposite to the Nursery and right next to Santa's Gift display
item.purpose: Allows players to complete the 'School' task and train pets
item.cardSummary: School is a need location. It is located in the center of Adoption Island, opposite to the Nursery and right next to Santa's Gift display. Allows players to complete the 'School' task and train pets.

item.name: Neon Cave
item.mapPosition: Under the main bridge connecting Adoption Island and the Neighborhood
item.purpose: To create Neon and Mega Neon pets
item.cardSummary: Neon Cave is a service location. It is located under the main bridge connecting Adoption Island and the Neighborhood. To create Neon and Mega Neon pets.

item.name: Nursery
item.purpose: Sells eggs and contains the VIP Room
item.cardSummary: Nursery is a service location. It is located in the center of adoption island. Sells eggs and contains the VIP Room.

item.name: Safety Hub
item.purpose: Grants access to the Trade License and the Code Redemption Kiosk
item.cardSummary: Safety Hub is a service location. It is located next to the Green Groceries. Grants access to the Trade License and the Code Redemption Kiosk.
